endpoint: aqueous solubility in HBSS at pH 7.4 after 18 hours, quantified by LC-MS/MS, as described in the primary article
sampling_interpretation: The data are a small, deliberately designed cyclic-peptide set and commercial controls; 35 of the 40 reported values exceed 100 micromolar.
representation_interpretation: Repeated sequence strings can correspond to distinct stereochemical structures, and cyclization/N-methylation are not faithfully represented by canonical ProtT5 or ESM-2 tokens.
limitations: The massively parallel PEGASUS training signals are permeability proxies, not direct solubility measurements.
The 40 direct-solubility rows are too small and too narrowly designed for a general pLM superiority benchmark.
